tests). Constructors ApplicationDbContext(DbContextOptions) Initializes a new instance of the ApplicationDbContext class. public ApplicationDbContext(DbContextOptions options) Parameters options DbContextOptions The options to be used by the DbContext. Properties ActionLog Gets or sets the audit records written by SaveChangesWithAuditAsync(Guid?, Formatting?). public virtual DbSet<ActionLog> ActionLog { get; set; } Property Value DbSet<ActionLog> Methods OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder) Configures the ActionLog entity mapping (table, index, column names and types) based on the current database provider. protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder) Parameters modelBuilder ModelBuilder The builder used to construct the model for this context. Remarks Derived contexts that override this method should call base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder) so that the ActionLog mapping is kept. SaveChangesWithAuditAsync(Guid?, Formatting?) Saves all changes made in this context to the database and writes an ActionLog record for every added, modified or deleted entity. public Task<int> SaveChangesWithAuditAsync(Guid? actionBy = null, FormattingHelper.Formatting? formatting = null) Parameters actionBy Guid? The identifier of the user making the change, stored in CreatedBy. formatting FormattingHelper.Formatting? The naming convention applied to ReferenceTable and ColumnName. When it is KYS.Library.Helpers.FormattingHelper.Formatting.SnakeCase, the keys of RecordValue are converted to snake_case as well. null keeps the original names. Returns Task<int> The number of state entries written to the database by the main save, including the audit records that could be created before saving. Remarks Changes are detected and an AuditEntry is built for each tracked entity (excluding ActionLog entities and detached or unchanged entries). Audit records whose values are already known are added, then the changes are saved. Audit records for entities with database-generated values (e.g. identity keys) are completed with the generated values and saved with a second SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken) call. The two saves are not wrapped in a transaction by this method. Use an IUnitOfWork (or an explicit transaction) if both must succeed or fail together. Exceptions InvalidOperationException An audit entry could not be converted to an ActionLog, for example because a name could not be formatted.

index.html.summary: KYS.EFCore.Library Documentation Welcome to KYS.EFCore.Library, a utility library for building data-access layers with Entity Framework Core in internal .NET applications. It provides Domain-Driven Design (DDD) building blocks, an audit-aware DbContext, an explicit Unit of Work, and the Specification pattern to reduce repeated persistence code and keep domain models consistent. This site contains a high-level overview of the library and a full API reference automatically generated from XML documentation comments. 📦 Project Modules KYS.EFCore.Library Core DDD building blocks: Entity<TId>: base entity with identity-based equality and domain events ValueObject: base value object compared by its components Enumeration: "smart enum" base class Specification<T>: composable query criteria (And/Or) IUnitOfWork / DbContextUnitOfWork<TDbContext>: explicit transaction handling IRepository<T>, IAggregateRoot, INotification: repository and domain event contracts KYS.EFCore.Library.DBContext Provides ApplicationDbContext, a base DbContext that records inserts, updates and deletes into an ActionLog table through SaveChangesWithAuditAsync. Table and column naming adapts automatically to PostgreSQL (snake_case) or other providers. KYS.EFCore.Library.Converters Contains EF Core value converters, such as storing an enum by its [Description] value instead of its numeric value. KYS.EFCore.Library.Extensions Extension methods for registering the Unit of Work in dependency injection and for querying a DbContext with a Specification<T>. ⚡ Quick Start // 1. Derive your DbContext from ApplicationDbContext public class AppDbContext : ApplicationDbContext { public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options) { } public DbSet<Order> Orders { get; set; } protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder) { base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder); // keeps the ActionLog mapping // your mappings... } } // 2. Register services builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString)); builder.Services.AddExplicitUnitOfWork<AppDbContext>(); // 3. Query with a specification var orders = await context.ApplySpecification(new ActiveOrdersSpecification()).ToListAsync(); // 4. Save with audit logging await context.SaveChangesWithAuditAsync(actionBy: userId, formatting: Formatting.SnakeCase); 🚀 Using This Library (Internal Use) Since this library is not currently published to NuGet, it can be consumed by: Cloning or downloading the repository Building the solution Locating the generated DLLs under: KYS.EFCore.Library/bin/Debug/net8.0/ or KYS.EFCore.Library/bin/Release/net8.0/ Adding the DLL references to your project manually: In Visual Studio: Project → Add Reference → Browse → Select DLLs In .NET CLI-based project: <ItemGroup> <Reference Include="KYS.EFCore.Library"> <HintPath>path/to/KYS.EFCore.Library.dll</HintPath> </Reference> <Reference Include="KYS.Library"> <HintPath>path/to/KYS.Library.dll</HintPath> </Reference> </ItemGroup> Note: KYS.EFCore.Library depends on KYS.Library, so both DLLs must be referenced. Manually referenced DLLs do not bring in their NuGet dependencies, so your project must also install: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore (9.x), Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Relational (9.x), CSharpFunctionalExtensions and Newtonsoft.Json, plus your database provider (e.g. Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL). 📘 API Reference Detailed class, method, and property documentation is available under the API section of this site. All content is generated automatically based on XML documentation comments in the source code. 📂 Project Structure KYS.EFCore.Library/ ├── Converters/ ├── DBContext/ │ └── Partials/ ├── Extensions/ ├── Entity.cs, ValueObject.cs, Enumeration.cs ├── Specification.cs └── IUnitOfWork.cs, DbContextUnitOfWork.cs, IRepository.cs (Classes and namespaces inside each module can be viewed through the API reference.) 🛠 Documentation This documentation is generated using DocFX and will stay updated as new XML comments are added or modified.
